Duck Council — theme explorations

Same scene in all four so they compare fairly: seven ducks (six illustrated, one user-created with a generated monogram), a split council, a real median of 55. Cards animate in on load to approximate how they will feel streaming over SSE.

OPTION 01
The Docket
Brutalist court filing. Hard black rules, offset shadows, stamped verdict, case caption. Brutal leads; groovy shows up only in the colour. Most legible, most severe.
OPTION 02
The Groovy Tribunal
Full 70s. Sunburst arch, Shrikhand display type, circular portraits in thick rings, score as a conic dial. Groovy leads and the court structure hangs off it. Warmest, most playful.
OPTION 03
Night Court
Dark brutalist. Hairline rules on near-black, Anton condensed masthead, duotone portraits, meter bars. Densest layout — two columns, scales best to thirteen ducks.
OPTION 04
The Green Bench
Institutional. Courthouse felt green, brass medallions, seal, DM Serif italics. Court of law leads; groovy survives in the serif and the warmth. Most dignified — the funniest verdicts land hardest against a straight face.
